intro.title:
A home on
*three levels*
intro.lede: Alvin, an architect, designed Bokkoms on three levels. Your guest flat is the whole lower level, 15 steps down from the front door — its own lounge, kitchen and two en-suite bedrooms, opening onto a patio with a braai, hammocks and part sea views.
intro.body: We live and work upstairs, so we are close by for advice or a hand whenever you need it, and out of the way when you don’t. Bring the dog, too: pets are welcome by prior arrangement.

quote.text: Stunning place, stunning location. Beautiful short walk to the beach in a very quiet area. Only the birds and waves to be heard!
